whenToUse: Volume and rate together: orders as bars with conversion rate as a line.
Two measures with different units that share a time axis.
avoidWhen: Two measures with the same unit — use a grouped Bar chart or Line chart.
More than two measures — split into separate charts.
a11y: Label both axes with units; the summary describes both series.
Do not rely on bar vs line colour only — the legend names each series.
